feature.scope: REPORTED completed assertions; literal clocks/journals/DOM only. Two asymmetric news clocks over the app’s own calendar parser, measured on the module, over HTTP, through the engine and its consumers, across a restart, through the settings dialog and through an upgrade of the committed M109 release. The sandbox has no market or calendar network, so the calendar is fed through the app’s own fetch path by a shim and no live-feed, provider, broker, pixel or human proof is claimed. RAW failures/early aborts, DECLARED assumptions and every frozen milestone-only schema negative remain SEPARATE. No claim about what a release does to price.

regression_parents.method: Actual c09574e M109 Git release as the M110 parent, the inherited M109 parent (the 14ac041 M108 release), the M107 parent (the 8a2cfd5 M107 release) and every older source by saved reverse patches asserted against the frozen parent-source.json proofs; no guessed schema/current module in any parent.

pre_hardening.compare: the engine stage IS the pre-hardening runtime (loose module + pass-through route, no ui and no docs), asserted identical to pre-hardening-source.json
faults: one number still sets both sides of the release (the 6-12x settle collapse), so a legacy single knob is split for the caller instead of refused
the settle floor is not applied to the route, so a short settle is not a 400 there
pre_hardening.parent_migration_split: On the parent the migration probe reports 10 passing assertions and 23 measured negatives, each named in analysis/evidence/m110/parent-migration.txt; the three assertions that still pass there are the ones the parent can answer about itself (its own history, its own single knob, its own restart), so they are not counted as feature coverage.
pre_hardening.why: On the pre-hardening runtime the unchanged probes measured 31/9 (api) and 39/1 (hardening); the hardening stage made the legacy knob a refusal and put the floor on every layer, and the same probes are 40/0 and 40/0 on the delivered tree.

smoke.harness: scripts/smoke-test.js from that same tree, unchanged
smoke.command: PORT=3210 node server.js + node scripts/smoke-test.js http://127.0.0.1:3210
smoke.environment: PORT=3210, TRADEJOURNAL_DB=/tmp/m110-smoke.db (fresh, synthetic), TJ_SCHEDULER=0, TJ_OFFLINE_CANDLES=1, no remote DB
smoke.conditional_view_count: The harness offers its view list conditionally (a chip condition on the content shell), so the reported total moves between samples: it is measured here at the same sample on both trees and the two counts are compared, not asserted absolutely.
smoke.news_dialog_coverage: grep -ci 'news' = 0 and grep -ci 'settings' = 2: the smoke run does NOT open the account dialog. The two settings fields are covered by analysis/probe-m110-ui.js (23 assertions), which drives the shipped dialog in jsdom against the real server.
smoke.limits: jsdom structural/DOM check with no browser engine: no pixel, device, audio, provider, broker, human or production proof, and no mental-state claim.

upgrade_from_actual_parent.why: The migration probe records the parent first (its own single `?window=` call echoed 5 and 45 on that very database), then compares sqlite_master object by object and table by table on the same file: the parent’s accounts text is an unbroken prefix of the upgraded text with the two documented definitions inserted, every other object and every inherited fact outside `accounts` is byte-identical, and the parent’s own code can still read the upgraded file.

news_window.judged_by_signed_offset: a release that has not printed is judged by the block, one that has printed by the settle; boundaries inclusive
news_window.m111_open: A calendar that cannot be fetched still reaches this rule as a quiet one (null blackout, no `unavailable` flag, no error on the payload); the pair is still echoed and a failure is not cached. Measured, not papered over.

scope: M110 the asymmetric news stand-down: two settings (pre-release block, post-release settle), applied by signed offset instead of one symmetric Math.abs window, with the settle floor enforced by the schema, the route and the module. It splits a window; it does not retune a grade — the news check keeps its weight and label, the state gate’s own 60-minute window is untouched, the risk guardrail still clamps beside it, and no fill padding, sample floor, clock, target, risk or grade moved. The one number he sanctions can no longer collapse the settle 6-12x below the 30-60 minutes he requires: a single knob is a refusal, not a split. M62’s surviving wording half is closed with it. M111 (the calendar fail-open) and M112 stay TODO. No 70%/causal/predictive/broker/provider/human/mental-state/pixel/production proof, and no predictor of any kind.
